author: Ankit
problem: Read Takahashi's height H. A plant is 0 cm tall on day 0 and grows 2^i cm during the night of day i. Print the first day on whose morning the plant is strictly taller than H.
bug_description: The loop runs over range(H) instead of range(H + 1), so for H = 1 it ends before day 2 and prints nothing.

comments.accurate: Adds each night's growth and prints the first morning the plant is taller than H
comments.wrong_behavior: Tries at most H days, since the plant's growth doubles every night
comments.wrong_location: Day loop verified; check that the day printed is i + 1 rather than i
